parts.text: This question is about sea water and the substances found in sea water.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Table 2.1 shows the masses of some of the compounds formed when 500 cm 3 of sea water is evaporated. Table 2.1 compound formula mass of compound / g sodium chloride NaCl 7.0 MgSO 4 2.5 potassium bromide KBr 1.5 calcium carbonate CaCO 3 1.0 Answer these questions using the information from Table 2.1.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The total mass of compounds formed from 500 cm 3 of sea water is 12.0 g. Calculate the total mass of compounds formed from 750 cm 3 of sea water. mass = .............................. g [1]

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text:
test: (add nitric acid / acidify and add aqueous) silver nitrate (1)
observations: cream precipitate (1)

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Calcium ions are in sea water. Complete Fig. 2.1 to show: • the electronic configuration of a calcium ion • the charge on the ion. Fig. 2.1 [2]

ms.label: 2(c)
ms.text:
electronic configuration 2,8,8 with no other shells added (1)
2+ / +2 outside brackets (1)

ms.label: 2(d)
ms.text:
arrangement: regular / in rows (1)
motion: vibrate (1)
